key_insight: The paper introduces task exchangeability, a condition that lets researchers leverage historical tasks with real data to make statistically valid inferences from synthetic data.
engineering_relevance: This provides a principled framework for using generated data in practical pipelines such as surveys and AI evaluation without sacrificing inference validity.
method: Identify historical tasks with real data that are exchangeable with the current task.
Use synthetic data under the task-exchangeability condition to obtain valid inference guarantees.
Extend the framework to settings that remain valid even beyond exact exchangeability.
evidence_signal: The framework is demonstrated on public opinion surveys using silicon samples and on AI evaluation using autoraters.
watch_item: Validity depends on finding suitable historical tasks and assessing whether exchangeability is plausible; biased or misspecified synthetic data can still undermine conclusions.
paper_title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
